title: Perfectly captured
text: I booked this only a few days ahead. Although, there was a complication with time we managed to work it out.  I met Helena she was warm and friendly from the beginning. She gave us ideas of poses and suggestions with no judgement. She let us embrace our silliness. The small group (4 others) was actually a nice bonus.
author: Jennifer

title: Great tour!
text: I loved this tour!! The photographer was very nice and friendly, he helped us to get the perfect pictures!
author: pferrerh

title: Most Fun Ever!!!
text: This was the best! Our photographer was fun and friendly and really wanted our pictures to come out great! I highly suggest this company!
author: Kleo142016

title: The best memories ever captured by this photographer
text: This was such a great experience with the photographer! I surprised my friend with this tour as a birthday gift during our vacation and it was the best gift ever. Our photos were magnificent and were sent to us faster than expected. Thank you so much—-
author: donniecewatson617

title: Very nice photographer and great pictures
text: Our photographer's name was Oscar. He was really extremely nice and helpful in choosing poses. We booked this photo tour as a couple. Simultaneously with us, three American girls were also present at the tour - but we found that not at all disturbing. We would recommend this tour to anyone who wants some amazing pictures on the one hand and wants to learn about the city on the other: Oscar is also a travel guide and therefore knows interesting facts about the various buildings, squares and alleys. Thank you Oscar!
author: johannesbro

title: Fun Shoot!
text: This was such a fun shoot! I was lucky to have a fun group and we laughed the whole way through. Helena was also super nice and made us at ease. There were five total solo travelers in our group but we quickly became comfortable and had a great time together. This shoot is a very reasonable priced option for a select few photos in areas you otherwise mightn’t have explored near Plaça Catalunya. I’m sort of picky and maybe a little too harsh on myself so of the 100+ sent I only really loved 3 photos. But having done a professional shoot before, I know out of a hundred shots you only really love
author: lanifinds

title: First time in Barcelona, great working with you! Photos turned out great.
text:
Thanks for the amazing photos! I knew they would come out great as soon as I saw your profile on Instagram.  Quick shoot - 1.5 hours with about 4 locations.  I have over 60+photos to choose from.  Thank you Helena for being great with this shoot! 

This tour was about total of 5 people (3 solos and 1 couple). Each location went by fairly quick. I wish I had more time shoot at other locations but I guess you save that for private shoots :). Thanks again for making first experience in Barcelona memorable!
author: gotfilipina305

title: Perfect. Flexible and fun
text: Helena was perfect from the start. Although we had no experience with photoshoots, she made us feel so comfortable and helped us with posing. Amazing pictures and tremendous value. Also her paella recommendations are great! Recommend 10/10
author: harrietkwok327

title: Glad we did it

Before starting, she explained that we were going to four locations in the Gothic Quarter and will be taking the photographs there. author: madsleepy

title: Great photos + Value for money!
text:
Travelled solo so I opted to avail of this service. Helena was very accommodating and patiently took photos and gave instructions as we went around the Gothic quarter. Was greatly impressed by the outcome of the photoshoot. Got around 170+ raw and edited photos from four different locations. Was lucky that there were only 2 of us booked for the 3pm session so there was lots of time.

Overall, it was a good experience! Reasonably priced and value for money. I compared it with other services and I’m very happy I chose this. Highly recommended esp if you want to have amazing photos in Barcelona a
